answer: I think this is a good idea. First, it is efficient for students to study with it. They can watch unclear parts again and again and skip sections they already understand. Second, it can provide more opportunities for students who want to study many subjects and spend many hours learning. Since it is free, they can study as much as they want without financial worries. Therefore, I think it is a good idea for people to provide free online video content to help students study by themselves at home.

Students who have sports practice or other activities can watch lessons when they return home. Second, videos can make reviewing difficult topics easier. Learners can pause a lesson, take notes, and watch important sections again. They should choose reliable videos and compare unfamiliar information with their school materials. However, when used carefully, free videos give many students a useful way to study independently without paying for extra lessons.
